{{Top|leg}}
'''''Berm''''' was a group of four [[Class-C cargo container]]s used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. They carried supplies for a Rebel installation. The installation was destroyed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.
